infobox.usage: Unlocks Airspace Control Center security room on Reserve.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-RH key (RB-RH) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base Airspace Control Center security room.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text:
The door is located in the White King building, third floor.

Path 1: Run up the stairs after passing the grate door, once you reach the 3rd floor, u-turn right and head down the hallway. finally turn right.

Path 2: Up the flight of metal stairs if entering from the White King server room.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Weapon rack spawn
- Weapon spawn on table.
- 2x Drawers
